referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A full-bleed photographic masthead with centered white copy and one orange pill action. An orange band follows with a short promise and a white action. Four icon-led feature columns sit on white, then a six-image workshop grid, a dark download band, a contact form, and a light footer. The typography is a rounded sans with large centered headings. Warm wood photography, orange, white, and charcoal create an energetic one-page studio tone.
